mapper.select: SELECT s.material_sku_id AS sku_id, SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM inv_stock s JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE w.type = 'MATERIAL' AND s.owner_type = 'OWN' AND s.material_sku_id IN #{id} GROUP BY s.material_sku_id

SELECT i.id, o.id AS po_id, o.no AS po_no, o.purchase_type, o.status AS po_status, i.material_sku_id AS sku_id, o.warehouse_id, w.type AS warehouse_type, i.qty, i.received_qty, i.returned_qty, i.conversion_factor AS factor, COALESCE(i.expect_date, i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) AS eta, i.calc_item_id AS owner_item_id, ci.calc_id AS owner_calc_id, c.status AS owner_calc_status FROM pur_order_item i JOIN pur_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = i.calc_item_id LEFT JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE i.material_sku_id IN #{id} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'CLOSED') AND ((o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND i.received_qty - i.returned_qty < i.qty) OR c.status = 'CONFIRMED'
OR ci.calc_id IN #{id}
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_calc_transit t JOIN mrp_calc_item ti ON ti.id = t.calc_item_id JOIN mrp_calc tc ON tc.id = ti.calc_id WHERE t.purchase_item_id = i.id AND (tc.status = 'CONFIRMED'
OR tc.id IN #{id} )))

SELECT t.id, ci.calc_id, t.calc_item_id, t.purchase_item_id AS line_id, t.qty FROM mrp_calc_transit t JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = t.calc_item_id JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE c.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ci.material_sku_id IN #{id}

SELECT ci.id, ci.calc_id, ci.material_sku_id AS sku_id, ci.use_stock_qty, ci.issued_qty FROM mrp_calc_item ci JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE c.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ci.block = 'PURCHASE' AND ci.material_sku_id IN #{id}
SELECT k.id FROM bas_material_sku k JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id WHERE k.safety_stock > 0 AND k.status = 1 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY k.id
